translations.web: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
translations.bsb: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
translations.kjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
